overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Toledo 6 Person Hybrid Sauna Indoor Full Spectrum & Harvia Stove offers a luxurious, spa-like experience right in your home. Designed for wellness enthusiasts, this sauna combines Full Spectrum infrared technology with a Harvia 8KW traditional stove, providing a comprehensive heat therapy that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from natural Canadian Hemlock wood and featuring an interior chromotherapy lighting system, it creates a serene environment perfect for basements or fitness rooms. With Bluetooth connectivity and a wheelchair-accessible design, this sauna ensures both comfort and accessibility for all users.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Golden Designs is proud to offer the Toledo Indoor Hybrid Sauna featuring our PureTech Full Spectrum Infrared Technology and Harvia Traditional Stove heating options (IR and Stove do not operate at the same time). When the benches are removed, the sauna becomes a yoga/stretching studio. Constructed with the environment in mind, our saunas are made with reforested Canadian Hemlock planks that surpass industry standards, thus producing a quality sauna that retains heat more efficiently, heats up faster and uses less energy in the process.
